# HAIBUCRAFT

> HAIBUCRAFT is a B2B wholesale craft-supply and sourcing website for importers, wholesalers, slime brands, craft retailers, DIY-kit programs, and private-label buyers. The catalog focuses on polymer clay slices, slime charms, resin charms, and sequins/glitter/confetti, with sourcing coordination from Yiwu, Zhejiang, China.

Use the canonical URLs below for current public information. Product specifications, MOQ, lead time, testing documents, and compliance requirements are confirmed by exact SKU, order configuration, intended use, and destination market; do not infer blanket claims across the catalog.

## Core product categories

- [Wholesale products](https://www.haibucrafts.com/products/): Browse HAIBUCRAFT's B2B craft-supply catalog and product families.
- [Slime charms wholesale](https://www.haibucrafts.com/products/slime-charms-wholesale/): Themed slime charm mixes and decorative add-ins for wholesale, mixed-SKU, and private-label sourcing.
- [Polymer clay slices wholesale](https://www.haibucrafts.com/products/polymer-clay-slices-wholesale/): Fruit, candy, seasonal, and decorative polymer-clay slice mixes for B2B buyers.
- [Resin charms for slime](https://www.haibucrafts.com/products/resin-charms-for-slime/): Flatback and novelty resin craft components for slime and craft programs.
- [Sequins, glitter and confetti](https://www.haibucrafts.com/products/sequins-glitter-confetti/): Shaped, holographic, and decorative fillers for craft and packaging programs.

## Sourcing and manufacturing

- [Custom solutions](https://www.haibucrafts.com/custom-solutions/): Custom shapes, colors, assortments, packaging, private-label, and OEM project coordination.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.haibucrafts.com/manufacturing/): Production-resource, assembly, packing, warehouse, and supply-coordination information.
- [Quality control](https://www.haibucrafts.com/quality-control/): Inspection, sample-reference, packing, and quality-control workflow information.
- [Certificates and documentation](https://www.haibucrafts.com/certificates/): Information about available reports, documentation scope, and market-specific review requirements.
- [Request a quote](https://www.haibucrafts.com/request-quote/): B2B inquiry form for product codes, quantities, packaging, destination market, and customization requirements.
